notes.title: 🚀 First Showcase! Orebits at Courage Cologne during DevCom 2025
notes.content:
[h1][b]Our first ever showcase is here![/b] 🎉[/h1][p][/p][p]On [b]August 19th[/b], we’ll be at [b]Courage Cologne[/b] during [b]DevCom 2025[/b] in [b]Köln, Germany[/b]. This will be the very first time [i]Orebits[/i] is shown publicly. We couldn’t be more excited to share it with you![/p][p]We’re bringing a fresh demo build for the event, and the flyers, shirts and stand decorations are coming in! Here’s a peek:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/5ca5ca7d20d62e2a77966df1e978d8cc83d4cef2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/48272898598745174155fbdbd3f6f9b3a59f0179.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674717/8ab5143360398ef04f0cb3077619841c2ba129d7.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]This showcase and 'real' physical stuff makes our game dev journey even more 'real'![/p][p][/p][h2]GamesCom[/h2][p]
We’ll also be walking the floors at [b]GamesCom[/b] on Thursday to soak in all the gaming goodness.[/p][p]If you’re [b]showcasing or visiting DevCom or GamesCom[/b] and want to meet up: drop a comment below! We’d love to meet fellow devs, gamers, and anyone curious about Orebits.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in Germany![/p]

notes.title: Orebits has a Steam page! What a nice milestone :)
notes.content: [h1]Orebits is live on Steam![/h1][p]Adding a storepage for Orebits is a big milestone to check off our (big) to do list! It takes a lot of work to build a nice Steam page: research, copywriting, capsules, screenshots, trailer, gifs, feature lists, and much more.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]But we have made it![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]We hope that you enjoy our Steam page and please let us know if you have any suggestions to improve it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]And of course: a wishlist would help us out so much![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here![/p]
